names.note: His own name, read out of «Sfântul Apostol și Evanghelist Ioan» — the line already recorded here, which names more than this saint (or joins two of the titles with “and”), so `pickNameForms` refuses to print it for one person and the reader was shown English instead.
Read out of «Άγιος Ιωάννης ο Θεολόγος (Μετάσταση)» in this folder’s Greek citation.

death.note: As printed by days.pravoslavie.ru for 26 сентября ст. ст.: “Преставление апостола и евангелиста Иоанна Богослова (начало II)”. The bounds are that phrase — the beginning of the second century — and not a recorded year.

feast.note: The Russian line is «Преставление», his falling asleep, and puts it at the beginning of the second century.

source.text: days.pravoslavie.ru, 26 сентября ст. ст. — «Преставление апостола и евангелиста Иоанна Богослова (начало II).»

feast.note: doxologia.ro also names him in «Soborul Sfinților 12 Apostoli» on 30 iunie, the Synaxis of the Twelve Apostles, whose life calls him «Sfântul Apostol și Evanghelist Ioan, Cuvântătorul de Dumnezeu» (read 24 September 2026). One row per church is the schema, so the second day is recorded here and he does not render on it.

source.text: doxologia.ro, 26 Septembrie — „Adormirea Sfântului Apostol și Evanghelist Ioan”
Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr), 26 Σεπτεμβρίου — «Άγιος Ιωάννης ο Θεολόγος (Μετάσταση)»

attestations.note: Not checked: pravoslavno.rs was read for 23 August – 19 September 2026 (10 August – 6 September ст. ст.); its page for this day was not read (2026-08-30).

hymns.text: Ἀπόστολε Χριστῷ τῷ Θεῷ ἠγαπηπημένε, ἐπιτάχυνον, ῥῦσαι λαὸν ἀναπολόγητον, δέχεταί σε προσπίπτοντα, ὁ ἐπιπεσόντα τῷ στήθει καταδεξάμενος· ὃν ἱκέτευε, Θεολόγε, καὶ ἐπίμονον νέφος ἐθνῶν διασκεδάσαι, αἰτούμενος ἡμῖν εἰρήνην, καὶ τὸ μέγα ἔλεος.

source.text: Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr) — Άγιος Ιωάννης ο Θεολόγος (Μετάσταση), Λειτουργικά κείμενα: Ἀπολυτίκιον

english.text: O Apostle beloved of Christ our God, make haste and deliver a people that has no defence; he who suffered thee to lean upon his breast receiveth thee as thou fallest down before him. Beseech him, O Theologian, to scatter the lingering cloud of the heathen, asking for us peace and great mercy.

hymns.text: Τὰ μεγαλεῖά σου Παρθένε, τὶς διηγήσεται; βρύεις γὰρ θαύματα, καὶ πηγάζεις ἰάματα, καὶ πρεσβεύεις ὑπὲρ τῶν ψυχῶν ἡμῶν, ὡς θεολόγος καὶ φίλος Χριστοῦ.

source.text: Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr) — Άγιος Ιωάννης ο Θεολόγος (Μετάσταση), Λειτουργικά κείμενα: Κοντάκιον

english.text: Thy mighty deeds, O virgin, who shall tell? For thou gushest forth wonders and wellest up with healings, and intercedest for our souls, as theologian and friend of Christ.

hymns.text: Apostole al lui Hristos de Dumnezeu iubite, grăbeşte de izbăveşte pe poporul cel fără de răspuns. Că te primeşte când cazi către El, Cel ce te-a primit când te-ai rezemat pe pieptu-I; pe Care roagă-L, de Dumnezeu cuvântătorule, şi norul păgânilor cel pus asupra noastră să-l risipească, cerându-ne nouă pace şi mare milă.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Apostol și Evanghelist Ioan (8 mai)

english.text: Apostle of Christ beloved of God, hasten to deliver a people who have no defence. He receives thee when thou fallest before him, who received thee when thou didst lean on his breast; entreat him, theologian, to scatter the cloud of the heathen set over us, and ask for us peace and great mercy.

hymns.text: Apostole iubite al lui Hristos Dumnezeu, grăbeşte de mântuieşte pe poporul cel fără de răspuns. Că te primeşte când cazi către Dânsul, Cel Ce te-a primit când te-ai rezemat pe pieptul Lui: pe Acela roagă-L, de Dumnezeu Cuvântătorule, ca norul vrăjmaşilor cel căzut asupra noastră să se risipească, cerându-ne nouă pace şi mare milă.

source.text: Doxologia — Tropar la Sărbătoarea Adormirii Sfântului Apostol şi Evanghelist Ioan

english.text: O Apostle beloved of Christ God, hasten to save a people that has no defence. He who received thee when thou didst lean upon His breast receives thee when thou fallest down before Him: entreat Him, O Theologian, that the cloud of enemies fallen upon us may be scattered, and that He may ask for us peace and great mercy.
